allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Asian Energy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 05, 2026, titled "Asian Energy Completes Warrant Conversion, raises Rs 92.03 crore By Issuing 36.63 Lakh Shares".

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Asian Energy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 36,62,702 Equity shares pursuant to exercise of convertible warrants allotted on Preferential Basis.

allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
